Guide.Title: Guide
Guide.Lead: How to run your salon here, one job at a time. Each part has a picture of the screen, the steps, and a button that takes you to that page. The pictures show a made-up salon.
Guide.Foot: Something missing or unclear? Tell us and we will add it.
Guide.Day.Title: Today's appointments
Guide.Day.Lead: The day list shows every visit of the day under the person who does it. It is the page to keep open at the desk.
Guide.Day.Step1: Open Appointments. Use Today and the arrows to move between days.
Guide.Day.Step2: When a client confirms, tap Confirm. When they walk in, tap Arrived.
Guide.Day.Step3: After the visit, tap Checkout to take the payment; the visit is then marked completed.
Guide.Day.Step4: If a client does not come, tap No-show. It is kept on their card.
Guide.Day.Step5: To cancel, tap Cancel and then "Yes, cancel the visit". The client is told and the time becomes free.
Guide.Book.Title: Booking for a client
Guide.Book.Lead: For a client who rings or stands at the desk.
Guide.Book.Step1: Tap New booking on the day list or the calendar.
Guide.Book.Step2: Choose the client (or add a new one), the service and the person, then tap Show times.
Guide.Book.Step3: Tap a free time. If the day is full, the page offers the next day that has a time.
Guide.Book.Step4: Save. The visit appears in the diary, and the client gets a confirmation if you have switched those on.
Guide.Services.Title: Services and prices
Guide.Services.Lead: What clients can book, how long each takes and what it costs.
Guide.Services.Step1: Open Services and tap Add a service: name, length in minutes and price.
Guide.Services.Step2: Write a short description. Clients see it under the service name when they book.
Guide.Services.Step3: Put the service in a category so clients can filter the list.
Guide.Services.Step4: Tick "Show under Popular" on the services you want clients to find first.
Guide.Services.Step5: If a person takes longer or charges differently, set it under "Staff prices and durations". Untick a person who does not do the service.
Guide.Staff.Title: Your team
Guide.Staff.Lead: Who works here, when, and who can be booked.
Guide.Staff.Step1: Open Staff and tap Add a staff member.
Guide.Staff.Step2: Set their working hours for each day of the week. Clients can only book inside them.
Guide.Staff.Step3: Add time off for holidays or a morning away; those times are closed for booking.
Guide.Staff.Step4: Add a photo. Clients see it when they choose who they want.
Guide.Online.Title: What your clients see
Guide.Online.Lead: Your booking page works on a phone and needs no account. Share its address on your social pages and messages.
Guide.Online.Step1: The client picks a service. They can search, filter by category, or tap Popular.
Guide.Online.Step2: They pick a day and a time. Only free times are shown.
Guide.Online.Step3: They choose who with, or "Anyone available".
Guide.Online.Step4: They can add another service to the same visit; each can be with a different person.
Guide.Online.Step5: They enter their name and mobile number, type the code sent by text, and the visit is in your diary.
